WINNIPEG--The following table is a recap of Statistics Canada's 
stocks report for the period ended July 31, 2026. Figures are in 
million metric tonnes. 
 
            Total Stocks   Total Stocks   5-year avg 
            July 31/26     July 31/25     (2021-25) 
Barley         0.940          1.249          0.873 
Canola         1.899          1.597          1.989 
Flaxseed       0.212          0.134          0.132 
Oats           0.577          0.507          0.734 
All wheat      6.649          4.240          5.071 
Durum          1.102          0.512          0.630 
Lentils        1.284          0.561          0.320 
Peas           1.182          0.489          0.447 
 
Source: Glacier FarmMedia, philfw@farmmedia.com
